name: services/groups/participant
description:
Get groups related to given user's study.

This means, that if the user is also a staff member, then this method will NOT include entries related to his staff-activities.
brief_description: Get groups related to given user's study

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of fields (as in the group method). Only primary fields are allowed.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: Either pl or en - resulting list of groups will be sorted by the course name in the specified language.

arguments.name: active_terms
arguments.description: Return only these groups which are related to the currently active academic terms.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary with the following fields:

  • groups - a dictionary mapping an Academic Term to an array of dictionaries as defined in the group method sorted by the course name in the specified language.

  • terms - a list of academic terms referenced (by ID) in the exams section sorted anti-chronologically. Format will be the same as in the terms/terms method.
